title: Debias-CLR: A Contrastive Learning Based Debiasing Method for Algorithmic Fairness in Healthcare Applications

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the differential association between feature embeddings and clinical phenotypes using the Single-Category Word Embedding Association Test (SC-WEAT) effect size metric, and evaluating downstream predictive performance (length of stay) using Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) and Cohen's Kappa.

Measuring the differential association between feature embeddings and clinical phenotypes (specifically comparing Hispanic vs. non-Hispanic representations) using the Single-Category Word Embedding Association Test (SC-WEAT) effect size metric, and evaluating downstream predictive performance (length of stay) using MCC and Cohen's Kappa.
